evidence_summary: Solr 8.2.0 with VelocityResponseWriter enabled in config. Velocity endpoint returns 500 (template missing but writer active). Config API accessible. CVE-2019-17558 affected version.
Solr 7.0.1 with VelocityResponseWriter enabled. /browse handler uses velocity templates. Config API accessible. CVE-2017-12629 affected version.
Solr 9.7.0 with no cores loaded. Velocity returns 404 (not available in Solr 9.x). Config API blocked (no core to query).
Solr 8.1.1 (CVE-2019-0193 lab) has VelocityResponseWriter enabled. This lab was intended as a negative for velocity testing, but velocity IS enabled. Not a valid negative for velocity backfill.
inconclusive_reason: CVE-2019-0193 lab has VelocityResponseWriter enabled. This is not a valid negative target for velocity testing.
